Image 50: ▪️Image 51: 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿Chelsea are ready to reward Estêvão with a new contract featuring improved terms. 

The 19-year-old is already signed until 2032, but the club want to acknowledge his patience.
